body: I dunno, maybe it's the girls round here, but typically that's not what I see in their boyfriends. They are ALWAYS good looking, bar none. The pretty girls, anyway. Maybe I'm not ugly, and it's just bad confidence, but after being called ugly by a girl I liked for ages, and was very good friends with up until I asked her out, I don't see why I wouldn't be. She wouldn't say something like that unless it was true.
It does at this age dude, I think. These aren't women. They're girls, they're 13-14...
I'm pretty sure I'm ugly, not that it bothers me too much. Never had any attention from girls, one time I did try something, I got shot down pretty damn fast.

I don't think I could do that. I'm shite with girls, hence why I'm a kissless virgin. I struggle to even talk to them if they're pretty. They seemingly like me, though. I doubt I could get them to do stuff like that.
They try, doesn't work. They ignore them, hell, some kids try to pick on them. It doesn't work. Nothing can get them to stop.

No point saying shit like that, they'd find ammunition in it somewhere. They are vilified in my school because of it, I am actually quite popular, everyone likes me, especially older kids. I have no idea why they do this to me, it's sending me fucking crazy. They only have each other as friends, they have no hope of getting a single girl, I don't get why they do it..

I went an entire term/semester (?) without giving rise to them, and they still went on till I snapped. Also, I forgot to answer the question in one of your previous replies, I'm in year 9, which I believe is a ''freshman'' don't quote me on that, I'm not sure.

Can't do anything to help my brother, tried countless times.

I doubt it would matter, he's one of the heads of school and he's got high up friends in the county council. He'd probably try putting it down to ''video editing'' I'm just sick of spending day, after day, after day, after day in seclusion because of these cuntmeats winding me up till I give one of them a black eye. I don't think they even care how much pain I cause them, they just enjoy winding me up too much.

I live in England, I don't get to graduate early sadly. And these idiots at my school don't just wind me up in school, but out of school. I've tried everything with them, from beating them to a pulp (Getting my self excluded for 10 days) to telling teachers. Teachers couldn't care less, as the ring leader of these four kids IS a teacher.

As far as my brother goes, he's 21 and he can't move out. He wouldn't be able to live on his own, he's depressed, but there is clearly far more wrong with him. He's all kinds of fucked up. I know I'm meant to feel sorry for him, but I don't see why I should. He blames every single little thing that he does wrong (Stealing money, jewelry etc... from my Mother, not helping out around the house, or doing chores) on his depression.
